performance_policy: Measure natural improvements; do not tune diffusion, tolerances or physical parameters to meet speed targets.

timers.rhs_regions: exclusive; diagnose/setup, reconstruction (includes pack and limiter), flux/CFL, column coupling, source, diffusion, physics, result copy
timers.radiation: child of RHS physics; never add to RHS or region total
timers.linear_solve: includes modal transforms and Helmholtz; separate from RHS
timers.observer: not a full RHS; diagnostic radiation is separate from integration radiation

counters.discarded: subset of total, includes thrown evaluation attempts; initial shared by retries is charged once

aggregation: whole intervals in (start,end]; reject straddling boundaries rather than invent partial integrated fluxes
